info.name: Integration Clinic: correct flow
info.description:
The correct Razorpay test-mode flow against the Integration Clinic demo. Set baseUrl to your deployment or http://localhost:3000. The first request sets an ic_session cookie, and Postman's cookie jar sends it on later requests, so all orders stay in one demo session.

To verify a real payment, finish Checkout in a browser, then either copy that tab's ic_session cookie into Postman's cookie jar or use 'Copy as cURL' on the scenario page.

Unofficial demo, not affiliated with Razorpay.

request.description: Send only the sku. The server owns the price and converts it to paise.
Paste the three values the Checkout handler returns. The server checks the HMAC with the key secret, then fetches the payment and checks status, order and amount.
All orders in this session, newest first, with status and fulfilment_count.
Returns a short_url. When it's paid, the payment_link.paid webhook marks the order paid.
Full refund of a paid order. Add "amount" (paise) for a partial refund. Status flips to refunded when refund.processed arrives.
